title: Cheddar-Panko Crusted Tofu with Creamy Bell Pepper & Broccoli Slaw

steps.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side, then cut the planks in half crosswise. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Place eggs in a medium bowl and beat with a whisk or fork until smooth. Set aside.
Grate cheese into another medium bowl. Add bread crumbs and spices, then stir to combine. Set aside.
Dip tofu planks into the beaten egg (letting the excess drip off), then into the bread crumb mixture, pressing gently to adhere. Transfer to a plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add breaded tofu and pan-fry until golden brown, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
While the tofu is cooking, place mayo in a clean medium bowl. Add vinegar, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; slice lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the broccoli slaw, and stir to combine.
To serve, divide slaw between plates or bowls. Top with tofu and enjoy!
